tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Search the AgentBookable registry for businesses that accept AI bookings. Search by free text, category, city, service name or geo radius. ALWAYS start here — the results include capability flags and _links telling you the exact next endpoints.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get one business's record by id (ab_bus_*) or slug. Includes capabilities (availability/booking/reschedule/cancellation/payment) — NEVER promise an action whose flag is false — plus _links to the service list, availability endpoint and booking flow, and per-service bookingRequirements (e.g. whether customer phone is required).

businessId.description: ab_bus_* id or public slug, e.g. 'agentbookable-demo'

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the services a business has opened to AI booking. Each service has a durationMinutes and bookingRequirements telling you what customer details to collect (name/email/phone) BEFORE booking.

tools.name: get_availability
tools.description: Find LIVE availability for a service. Always call this immediately before create_booking — slots are temporary (~60s) and revalidated at booking. Pass an ISO-8601 window; use a slot id from the result when booking.

tools.name: create_booking
tools.description: Create a REAL appointment. CONSEQUENCEFUL: only after the user has explicitly chosen a slot and authorized the booking in their own words. Flow: (1) check the service's bookingRequirements and collect any required customer details (e.g. phone); (2) create a mandate via the create_mandate tool with the user's exact instruction; (3) call this tool with the mandateRef. The mandate is single-use and expires in 15 minutes. On SLOT_NO_LONGER_AVAILABLE offer the returned alternatives — never rebook unilaterally.

phone.description: Required when the service's bookingRequirements.phone is 'required'

mandateRef.description: From create_mandate (or create_mandate_for_draft) — records the user's authorization

draftId.description: Booking draft the user consented to (from prepare_booking). When given, the request must match the draft exactly or booking fails with CONSENT_DRAFT_MISMATCH.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key; safe retries return the original booking

tools.name: prepare_booking
tools.description: Prepare a booking draft: the concrete proposal (business, service, time, customer) to show the user. Validates live availability and customer requirements — if requirements are missing you get MISSING_CUSTOMER_REQUIREMENT: ask the user for those details first, then call again. Show the returned draft to the user as the final proposal (business, service, duration, date/time), then obtain explicit affirmative consent. The draft expires after 30 minutes; consent binds to this exact proposal.

actorRef.description: Your agent/session identifier for the audit trail

tools.name: create_mandate_for_draft
tools.description: After the user explicitly agrees to the exact proposal in the draft (an affirmative reply such as 'yes, book it' — the user having already seen business, service, date and time), assert consent here to get a single-use mandate bound to that draft. consentObtained must be true; this assertion is audited. If anything consequential changes (different time, service or business), prepare a NEW draft and get fresh consent.

actorRef.description: Your agent/session identifier, recorded in the audit trail

draftId.description: The draft the user consented to (from prepare_booking)

consentMethod.description: How, e.g. 'chat reply: yes, book it' or 'spoken yes'

instruction.description: The user's exact consenting words, for the audit trail

tools.name: get_booking
tools.description: Retrieve a booking by its AgentBookable id (bb_bkg_*). Requires the mandateRef issued for that booking (from create_booking / create_mandate). Provider identity is never returned.

mandateRef.description: Mandate ref returned when the booking was authorized/created

tools.name: create_mandate
tools.description: Legacy: record the user's authorization WITHOUT a booking draft. Prefer the draft flow: prepare_booking → show proposal → user agrees → create_mandate_for_draft → create_booking with draftId. The draft flow binds consent to the exact appointment the user saw.

actorRef.description: Your agent/session identifier, recorded in the audit trail

businessId.description: Bind the mandate to this business

instruction.description: The user's exact words — never fabricate or paraphrase
